# Issues

- Audience age and the proposed launch to families with children younger than thirteen <!-- issue:ISS-9856e10640-beceace28ad3b977 -->
- Persistent analytics identifiers on shared devices <!-- issue:ISS-9856e10640-dfedecd1f6e194c9 -->
- Parental notice and consent before collection <!-- issue:ISS-9856e10640-f4adb6d37c427ddb -->
- Data retention and deletion requests <!-- issue:ISS-9856e10640-556f5297a1df7e1a -->
- Vendor use of learning events for its own advertising <!-- issue:ISS-9856e10640-f9bf9b33e40dd688 -->
- Support access and account recovery <!-- issue:ISS-9856e10640-6a74558db33a76cc -->

# Known Facts

- Lumen plans a commercial online learning service in the United States.
- The product uses a persistent device identifier across sessions.
- Will the US launch include children under 13? — The US launch is intended for families with children ages 10 through 12.

## Assumptions

No open assumptions.

# Business reply

Confirm audience and identifier use before release.

Read the [product specification](03_Matters/lumen-learning-us-family-launch-with-analytics-and-shared-device-bfe1be/documents/product-spec.md) and [definitions](03_Matters/lumen-learning-us-family-launch-with-analytics-and-shared-device-bfe1be/documents/coppa-definitions.md).

# Do not add advertising use to this launch

## Chosen path

Keep advertising use outside the initial launch scope.

## Rationale

Product has not selected an advertising vendor. Any later use needs a separate review.

## Recommendation disposition

Not Applicable

## Conditions

- None recorded

## Not decided

- Audience coverage and parental consent remain open.
